result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by giving Licensee a 30-day convenience-termination right, requiring a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and denying Licensor a convenience-termination right during any committed term. However, allowing termination “in part” is unnecessary and undefined, and “without ... further liability” could unintentionally eliminate accrued or surviving obligations. The placement of subsection IV after Article XX also creates structural ambiguity. These issues expand beyond the playbook and risk altering unrelated commercial intent.
